    North Atlantic · 14–15 April 1912

    Titanic: The Final Hours

    A real-time 3D reconstruction, minute by minute, from the lookout's bell at 23:39 to Carpathia's rescue at dawn. Every event runs on the ship's own clock at one second per second: the 2 h 40 min sinking, the 20 lifeboats, the break-up, and the six-minute fall to the seabed 3,800 m down.

    Sound on recommended. Chapters let you skip ahead; time itself never speeds up. Deep-sea scenes are lit as if by a survey submersible; in reality it is pitch black below 250 m. Open the 2D physics sandbox
